fullContentHtml:

The NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 has been released on 31st December 2025. The result can be checked and downloaded from the official NIACL website (newindia.co.in). The NIACL AO Phase 2 (Mains) examination conducted on 29th October 2025 was held for the recruitment of Administrative Officers. The result PDF lists the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the NIACL AO interview 2025.

NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 Out

The NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 is now available on the official website of the New India Assurance Company Limited (NIACL). Candidates who appeared for the Phase 2 examination on 29th October 2025 can check the PDF to see the roll numbers of those shortlisted for the NIACL AO interview 2025. This marks the next step in the recruitment process for the Administrative Officer post.

NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 Download Link

The NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 can now be downloaded from the official website of the New India Assurance Company Limited. The result is published as a PDF listing the roll numbers of candidates who appeared for the Phase 2 exam. Only those whose roll numbers appear in the PDF have cleared the mains examination and are eligible to move on to the interview stage.

The NIACL AO Result 2025 PDF has been uploaded online for public access and candidates are advised to download it directly from the official portal. After opening the file candidates can simply search their roll number to confirm their qualification status. It is recommended to save a copy of the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 PDF for future reference.

NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 PDF: Click to Download

How To Download NIACL AO Phase 2 Result 2025?

The NIACL AO Phase 2 Result 2025 is released online in PDF format on the official NIACL website. Candidates do not need any login credentials to check the result as it is published as a list of shortlisted roll numbers. Following the correct steps will help avoid confusion while downloading the result.

Steps to download NIACL AO Mains Result 2025:

  1. Visit the official website of the New India Assurance Company Limited.
  2. Go to the careers or recruitment section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link related to the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025.
  4. The result PDF will open on the screen.
  5. Use the search option to find your roll number in the PDF.
  6. Download and save the result file for future reference.

Details Mentioned On NIACL AO Mains Result 2025

The NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 PDF shows the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the interview stage. It is important to check the PDF carefully to see if the roll number appears. Since the PDF contains only roll numbers it should be downloaded and saved for future reference. This ensures that candidates who cleared the mains exam are eligible for the NIACL AO interview 2025.

NIACL AO Mains Cut Off 2025

The NIACL AO Mains Cut Off 2025 shows the minimum marks needed to move to the interview stage. The result PDF only has roll numbers so candidates whose roll numbers are listed have cleared the cut off for their category. Clearing this cut off means candidates are now eligible for the next step. Those who qualify should start preparing for the interview as the final NIACL AO Result 2025 will be announced after the interview round. This cut off is an important step in getting closer to the Administrative Officer post.

NIACL AO Score Card 2025

The NIACL AO Score Card 2025 has now been released for candidates who appeared in the Phase 2 (Mains) examination. This score card shows the marks obtained by candidates in the NIACL AO Mains Exam 2025 and helps them understand their performance before the interview round. Candidates can download their individual score card from the official NIACL website using their roll number and date of birth. The NIACL AO Score Card 2025 is an important document and aspirants should save it carefully as it may be required during the interview and final selection process.

What Next After NIACL AO Result 2025 Mains Declaration?

The NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 has been released and candidates who qualified should start preparing for the interview round. The interview is the final stage for the selection of Administrative Officers. All details about the interview schedule, venue and required documents are available in the result PDF or on the official NIACL website. Candidates should gather essential documents like educational certificates and identity proof to be ready for the NIACL AO interview 2025.

Candidates should keep all important documents ready in advance, including educational certificates, identity proof and any other papers mentioned in the official notice. Being well prepared will help candidates attend the NIACL AO interview 2025 confidently. It is also helpful to stay updated with current affairs and basic insurance knowledge as these topics are often asked during the interview.

NIACL AO Mains Result FAQs

Q1. How to check the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025?
The result can be checked on the official NIACL website. Candidates need to open the mains result PDF and search the roll number to confirm selection for the interview stage.

Q2. When will the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 declared?
The mains result has been officially declared on 31st December 2025 and is available in PDF format on the official website.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025?

The result PDF contains only the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the interview stage.

Q4. What are the next steps after the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025?

Candidates listed in the result will proceed to the interview stage. All instructions regarding the interview schedule, venue and required documents are provided in the result PDF or on the official NIACL website.

Q5. Where is the NIACL AO Mains Result 2025 PDF available?
The result PDF is available on the official website of the New India Assurance Company Limited, under the careers or recruitment section. Candidates can access it directly to check their selection status.
